bull_bear.body:
- Part of the Hathway group — Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited is the holding company, and the Company adopts HCDL's group-wide risk management framework
- Customer-centric service approach with customised packages aimed at strengthening customer confidence and the subscriber base
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Downturn in the CATV industry — The Board's Report explicitly states that 'the downturn in the CATV industry has presented certain challenges' to the Company. As a pure cable-television service provider, the Company's subscriber base and revenue are directly exposed to the structural decline of the CATV industry; management's only stated mitigant is a customer-centric approach with customised packages intended to strengthen customer confidence and support subscriber growth in coming years.
- Revenue contraction and a swing to a loss at both standalone and consolidated level — The Board's Report narrative records that revenue from operations was lower than the prior year on both a standalone and consolidated basis and that the Company reported a loss after tax against a profit in the prior year, with retained earnings remaining in deficit. On a very small revenue base this leaves little cushion, and the Board recommended no dividend and transferred no amount to reserves for the year under review.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: The Company provides Cable Television (CATV) services, focusing on delivering seamless viewing to subscribers and engaging with customers to understand their entertainment preferences and offer customised packages aligned with their requirements. It operates as a subsidiary of Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited (HCDL) and, following the acquisition during the year of the remaining 49% stake in Hathway Bhawani NDS Network Limited, holds that entity as a wholly owned subsidiary. Management notes that the CATV industry is in a downturn but expects its customer-centric approach to support growth in the subscriber base in coming years.

business.body:
- Hathway Bhawani NDS Network Limited — subsidiary: Wholly Owned Subsidiary with effect from 06.02.2026, after the Company acquired the remaining 49% stake during the year; Form AOC-1 records it as a subsidiary since 13/10/10. It was a Joint Venture up to 05.02.2026. Not a Material Subsidiary as on March 31, 2026; it has commenced operations and was neither liquidated nor sold during the year.
- Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited — related party: Parent / Holding Company; the Company follows HCDL's group Risk Management Policy and framework.
- Hathway Digital Limited — related party: Fellow Subsidiary.
- Reliance Industries Limited — related party: Entity exercising control over the Parent.
- Reliance Industrial Investments and Holdings Limited — related party: Entity exercising control over the Parent; Protector of Digital Media Distribution Trust and wholly owned subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited; under common control of KMPs and/or relatives of KMPs of the enterprise exercising control over the Parent.
- Digital Media Distribution Trust — related party: Entity exercising control over the Parent; Reliance Content Distribution Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited, is its sole beneficiary.
- Jio Content Distribution Holdings Private Limited — related party: Entity exercising control over the Parent; controlled by Digital Media Distribution Trust.
- Jio Internet Distribution Holdings Private Limited — related party: Entity exercising control over the Parent; controlled by Digital Media Distribution Trust.
- Jio Cable and Broadband Holdings Private Limited — related party: Entity exercising control over the Parent; controlled by Digital Media Distribution Trust.
- Mr. Dhiren Dalal — related party: Key Management Personnel — Independent Director (w.e.f. 07.08.2024).
- Mr. Basant Kumar Parasramka — related party: Key Management Personnel — Independent Director (w.e.f. 07.08.2024).
- Mr. Vatan Pathan — related party: Key Management Personnel — Non-Independent Director; signs the Board's Report as Director & CEO (DIN: 07468214).
- Mrs. Vrinda Mendon — related party: Key Management Personnel — Non-Independent Director (DIN: 08424835).

outlook.body:
- Enhance customer experience through the introduction of various offerings and initiatives aimed at delivering seamless Cable Television (CATV) services
- Strengthen customer service standards and actively engage with customers to understand their entertainment preferences and offer customised packages aligned with their requirements
- Consolidate ownership of the subsidiary — the Company acquired the remaining 49% stake in Hathway Bhawani NDS Network Limited during the year, making it a wholly owned subsidiary
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The Annual Report discloses no capacity addition, plant, network build-out or capital-expenditure project. The only expansion-type action recorded is corporate: during the year under review the Company acquired the remaining 49% stake in Hathway Bhawani NDS Network Limited, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The Board also records that there have been no material changes and commitments affecting the financial position of the Company between the end of the financial year and the date of the Report, and that as on March 31, 2026 the Company does not have any Material Subsidiary.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Management flags a downturn in the CATV industry that has presented certain challenges to the business
- Management states it remains optimistic that its continued customer-centric approach will help strengthen customer confidence and support growth in its subscriber base in the coming years
